topic: The creator who secretly put his own trauma into every single episode
hook: He hid his trauma inside every episode. Nobody noticed for years.
script: He hid his trauma inside every episode. Nobody noticed for years. Hideaki Anno created Neon Genesis Evangelion while suffering severe clinical depression. Shinji's paralysis and self-loathing mirror Anno's own breakdown. The final two episodes — abstract, dialogue-free, set inside Shinji's mind — were made when the budget ran out and Anno was hospitalised. What looked like artistic choice was a man falling apart on screen. Follow for anime that reveal the human cost of creation.
